correctness.rationale: In a finite model of dimension N, for M=ker(A-P), M0=M∩zH² has dimension at most dim M, and the quotient (M+S*M0)/M has dimension at most both dim M and N-dim M. Thus if d=2r+1, N≥2d=4r+2. At equality dim M=dim M0=d and M⊕S*M=Kθ. For the explicit θ=z^(4r+2), A=J^(2r+2)+(J*)^(4r+1), P=Σ e_(2j+1)⊗e_(2j+2) exactly rank r, solve Bx=0 to obtain independent u0=e1, u_(2j+1)=e_(2j+2)+e_(2r+2+2j+1), u_(2j+2)=e_(2j+3). The images BJu0=e_(4r+1), BJu_(2j+1)=e_(2j), BJu_(2j+2)=-e_(2j+1) are independent, so d(M)=2r+1. This is a symbolic all-positive-r proof; the finite replay for r=1,2,3,5,7,13,30 checks coordinates, rank and complementarity, not the infinite quantifier.
